scientific_integrity: All-n argument is analytic; finite exhaustive checks are corroboration. Some unindexed permutation enumeration may imply the formula. Review is self-review only, no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a cycle with one fixed casting voter, distinct one-shot time stamps, retrospective trust, confluent roots and the stated optional final-round abstainer realization; no claim for multiple gurus, tied times, non-retrospective trust or real behavioral samples.
title: Exact full-participation probabilities for one-shot temporal delegation cycles
